summary: Households are largest when the head of the household is between 35 and 44.
realLife: Household size peaked at 3.2 people when the householder was 35 to 44, and families with their own children under 18 averaged 4.0 people.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, Average U.S. Family Size Just Over Three People (America Counts, Nov 17, 2026): https://www.census.gov/library/stories/2026/11/average-household-size.html
